summary: Local Gaussian right inverse, stationary transmission and on-shell presymplectic boundary term for the existing positive-H real-linear graded comparator with determinant-derived relative center.

stage_events.description: The repository author fixes the single full-Theta covariant tetrad, central sharp metric and architecture-before-repair constraints; the present work stays within that documented research boundary.
Reuse audit distinguishes the older free central one-form from the derived-H graded comparator and identifies its local representability and variational boundary gap.
Construct a non-null Gaussian representative with positive H, derive its exact right inverse, use Y=X/h for the complete local variation and obtain the stationary presymplectic pullback identity.
Exact SymPy controls and a separately implemented NumPy finite-difference check test both normal signs, complete tetrads, determinant signs, variation and boundary identities.

evidence.supports: Documented author-controlled architecture and scope requirements.
